import itertools, math
# ordered path and port choices, pairing choices
links=[('8','6',shapes['8']['ports'],[(2,11),(7,11)]),
       ('6','9a',[(3,16),(6,16)],[(4,21),(9,22)]),
       ('9a','4',[(3,25)],[(15,10)]),
       ('4','7',[(16,15)],[(18,15),(20,15)]),
       ('7','5',[(22,17)],[(19,4),(21,5)]),
       ('5','9b',[(20,1),(23,1)],[(13,24),(15,24)])]
sol=[]
for choices in itertools.product(*[list(itertools.product(a,b)) for _,_,a,b in links]):
    trans={'8':(0,0)}
    for (a,b,_,_), (pa,pb) in zip(links,choices):
        tra=trans[a]; trans[b]=(tra[0]+pa[0]-pb[0],tra[1]+pa[1]-pb[1])
    pixsets={k:{(r+trans[k][0],c+trans[k][1]) for r,c in v['pix']} for k,v in shapes.items()}
    if any(pixsets[x]&pixsets[y] for x,y in itertools.combinations(shapes,2)): continue
    ports={k:{(r+trans[k][0],c+trans[k][1]) for r,c in v['ports']} for k,v in shapes.items()}
    # connector points may coincide but don't overlap colored pixels of any component
    allpix=set().union(*pixsets.values())
    if any(p in allpix for ps in ports.values() for p in ps): continue
    pts=allpix|set().union(*ports.values())
    rmin=min(r for r,c in pts); rmax=max(r for r,c in pts); cmin=min(c for r,c in pts); cmax=max(c for r,c in pts)
    area=(rmax-rmin+1)*(cmax-cmin+1)
    sol.append((area,rmax-rmin+1,cmax-cmin+1,choices,trans,rmin,rmax,cmin,cmax))
len(sol)
